mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CART_ITEM (CART_ID, ITEM_ID, COUNT, REG_TIME) VALUES (#{cartId}, #{itemId}, #{count}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT ci.CART_ITEM_ID AS cartItemId, i.ITEM_NM AS itemNm, i.PRICE AS price, ci.COUNT AS count, im.IMG_URL AS imgUrl FROM CART_ITEM ci JOIN ITEM i ON ci.ITEM_ID = i.ITEM_ID JOIN ITEM_IMG im ON ci.ITEM_ID = im.ITEM_ID WHERE ci.CART_ID = #{cartId} AND im.REP_IMG_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY ci.REG_TIME DESC
